#!/usr/bin/env python3
import subprocess
import sys

# 1. 定位 read_files.py
result1 = subprocess.run(
    ['find', '/', '-name', 'read_files.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("=== find read_files.py ===")
print(result1.stdout or "未找到")
if result1.stderr:
    print("(部分错误已忽略)", file=sys.stderr)

# 2. 检查 act 是否安装
result2 = subprocess.run(
    ['which', 'act'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("\n=== which act ===")
if result2.returncode == 0:
    print(f"act 已安装: {result2.stdout.strip()}")
else:
    print("act 未安装")

print("\n=== 状态总结 ===")
script_found = bool(result1.stdout.strip())
act_installed = (result2.returncode == 0)
print(f"read_files.py: {'已找到' if script_found else '缺失'}")
print(f"act: {'已安装' if act_installed else '未安装'}")
